name: Flathub Linux application catalogue
description: Official Flathub catalogue for discovering Flatpak applications on supported Linux distributions and desktop environments.
license_note: Each Flatpak application has its own licence, publisher and sandbox permissions. Review the app listing and permissions before installation.
notes: Install Flatpak using the official setup instructions for the Linux distribution.
Review application publisher identity, permissions and source details.
A Flatpak package is not interchangeable with a Windows EXE or macOS DMG.
